basics.name: Rana Khonsari
basics.label: Data Scientist
basics.summary: I am a data scientist with 4 years of experience developing machine learning models for object detection, segmentation, and tracking using Python. I have expertise in designing novel computer vision pipelines.

work.name: Deutsches Forschungszentrum für Künstliche Intelligenz (DFKI)
highlights: Developing object detection and tracking systems using multi-sensor inputs from cameras and LiDARs.

work.name: Porsche Engineering
highlights: Designed a novel monocular approach for online, auxiliary-free multi-object tracking without relying on specialized detectors, as part of the AVEAS research project.
Built a tracking pipeline with detection, filtering, and matching modules, achieving accurate tracking of traffic participants.
Achieved a top AMOTA score of 69.59 on the KITTI validation set and a 78.03 MOTA on MOT17, while demonstrating competitive performance on DanceTrack and MOT17 test sets.

work.name: August-Wilhelm Scheer Institute
highlights: Contributed to the FishAI project by implementing and fine-tuning object detection and segmentation models (Mask RCNN, YOLOv5, YOLOv8) to achieve a mAP of 0.902 in fish detection.
Developed a pipeline to estimate fish lengths with only 3.32% error from pixel-length measurements under a monocular camera setup and calculated weights with 12.24% error.
Expanded datasets by leveraging OwlViT and SAM. Generated bounding boxes with OwlViT and used them as prompts for SAM to create high-quality segmentation masks.

work.name: Saarland University
highlights: Tutored the 'Image Acquisition Methods' course, focusing on the properties and limitations of various imaging techniques (e.g., acoustic and medical imaging).

work.name: Ratous Company
highlights: Developed an ID authentication system using live video and ID images. Collected 35,000 real and fake video frames to address overfitting, improving validation accuracy by 30.4%.
Enhanced OCR accuracy by 8% using image augmentation to simulate diverse optical conditions in ID card images.

projects.name: Bachelor's Final Project @ IUST
highlights: Improved facial expression recognition accuracy to 87.5% on the FER2013 dataset by building and training a convolutional neural network.
Leveraged techniques like Dropout, Data Augmentation, and Landmark Detection to optimize performance.
